author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Runs one creator-controlled Starting Soon countdown with a custom completion message and optional local tone.
changelog: 2.4.1: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.1 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.0: initial release with bounded persistent countdown state, explicit scene-friendly controls, a customizable core-hosted overlay, completion message, optional synthesized tone, and separate Streamer.bot import.

manifest.name: Starting Soon Countdown
installationSteps: Install and enable the add-on, then configure the duration, completion message, optional tone, and overlay style.
Attach Start to the scene-active trigger for your Starting Soon scene.
Attach Stop to the scene-inactive trigger for that scene, or use Reset if the paused clock should remain visible.
Add the countdown overlay URL shown by the wizard to OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs Desktop.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its small timer state remains available unless add-on data is explicitly deleted.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded countdown controls, persistence, and overlay publishing.
